title: SID MEDICOS to participate in AMWC Latin America 2026 in Colombia, building on its engagement in Mexico
summary: SID MEDICOS, a global beauty and aesthetics company, is continuing to expand its engagement across Latin America as it heads to Colombia following two industry events in Mexico

extraction.key_fact: SID MEDICOS가 멕시코 행사에 이어 콜롬비아 AMWC 라틴 아메리카에 참가한다.
